scope: Independent boundary-pattern advice for initial extraction; not a final textual QC pass.

recommendations.rule: Preserve section headings and chapter-level notes separately
recommendations.detail: The short title and expanded title may differ; expanded titles may cover several lines. A chapter note may intervene before the printed page-range line. Do not drop the whole pre-reference region as redundant headers.

recommendations.rule: Use occurrence records for both full narration and explicit route/variant summaries
recommendations.detail: A summary that says the same narration was transmitted by another route is a distinct source occurrence but contains no full matn. Keep it as variant_reference with relationship to preceding account; never expand from the parent or invent route counts.

recommendations.rule: Distinguish nested speaking from a new narration
recommendations.detail: は伝えている or によると alone cannot determine record boundaries. Continuation qualifiers such as さらにつづけて and さらに must be tested in context; quotation depth is supporting evidence but is unreliable where source quotations are unbalanced.
At least one explicit variant starts immediately after the preceding quote mid-line (PDF 266). New narrator openings also span line/page breaks.

recommendations.rule: Footnote scope is semantic and cross-page
recommendations.detail: Start at a note-definition marker, continue until the next definition, explicit new occurrence or section boundary. Sentence end alone is insufficient; some notes do not end with punctuation. Source note text can contain cited hadith and Arabic.

recommendations.rule: Preserve complete raw source-unit text and location spans
recommendations.detail: Retain source_unit_text_verbatim plus start/end line+character offsets so later boundary corrections need no re-extraction. Do not silently normalize spelling/punctuation/quotation imbalance.

examples.text: った 「アッラーよ、私を邪悪と忌わしき事々からお護り下さい！」前記と同内容のハディースは
examples.decision: Split the explicit variant at 前記と同内容 within the line; body before the variant stays first occurrence.

examples.text: アーイシャはさらにつづけて次のように伝えている。
examples.decision: Continuation of report begun earlier, not a new occurrence.

examples.text: さらにウバイドッラーは次のように伝えている。
examples.decision: Continues the same report with the transmitter verification anecdote; do not blindly split.

と礼拝を共にした教友を根拠としたサーリハ・ビン・ハウワートの話を伝えている

に家が建てられるであろう」（というハディースを）同一の伝承者経路で伝えている。
examples.decision: A quoted variant summary distinct from previous report; avoid losing because keyword is at end.

examples.decision: New occurrence starts directly with quote; source first-occurrence rule catches it.

examples.decision: New source-section first occurrence without explicit transmission formula.

examples.decision: Ancillary quotation in source footnote; flag embedded narration; do not imply independently verified source/grade.

examples.decision: Source compiler dialogue/comments surrounding narration; mark in source context, not a fabricated new prophetic narration.

examples.text: この後半のハディースは前記と同内容であるが、次の表現が付加されている
examples.decision: Continuation summary within current explicitly introduced variant, not an additional occurrence on its own.

examples.text: 以下は前記ハディースと同じことを伝えている。
examples.decision: Continuation after current narrator opener; do not create separate record for this sentence.
